dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, linear 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the anterior-mid section toward the posterior extremity.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-to-medium grey normalized pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse dark-pixel patches distributed across the mid-dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary skin tone and localized pigmented regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A prominent, dark-pigmented longitudinal linear feature located on the central dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear topological groove or indentation coinciding with the central longitudinal marking.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single longitudinal linear mark on the dorsal surface, characterized by high-contrast pigmentation relative to the baseline canvas.
